title: SYNC Starter Kit (3 x 2ml)
description:
The S-compatible device of the ALLO SYNC allows ultimate flexibility. Enjoy Allo’s best flavours in a closed pod system or choose pods from pre-existing major brands. SYNC’s superior pod design helps prevent leaking and spit back so you get consistent, prefect puffs every time with the smart chipset. Their mesh coils produce rich, vibrant flavour and vapor.

With a powerful 450mAh battery with USB-charging port, your device will fully charge in just 20 minute! The LET light changes colour to indicate battery life so you know when it’s nearing time to charge up again.

Kit comes with

- ALLO SYNC device

- USB Type C charging cable

- 1 x Frost 2ml pod

- 1 x Blue Raspberry 2ml pod

- 1 x Pineapple Ice 2ml pod

Compatible with

- ALLO SYNC Pods

- STLTH Pods

- S-compatible pods
